notes: Renders a native <button type="button">. Nothing here overrides `type`, so a Button inside a form will not submit it — a submit button is a different contract, or a prop this one does not yet have.

The `hierarchy` axis is spelled `hierarchy`, not `role`, for the reason the React binding gives: `role` is a real HTML attribute and a button carrying role="primary" would stop being announced as a button. That reason is about HTML, not about React, so it holds here word for word — which is evidence the axis name belongs to the canon and not to either backend.

`loading` is `control: consumer` and the contract says it must reach assistive technology as well as the eye. Nothing in the contract says HOW; `aria-busy` is the conventional answer and the emitter has no way to know that.
